fact: The remote sensing-based GEOCIF maize yield forecast model, downscaled to Admin-2 level in Malawi by NASA Harvest, was provided to the Ministry of Agriculture with monthly updates in the 2022/2023 season and again in 2023/2024 to support its regular crop estimates.
title: NASA Harvest Partners with FAO to Improve Agricultural Monitoring Across Malawi, Namibia, and Kazakhstan
